author: Harry
text: the first one i think is valid as the price return to clear the bases it formed while moving up (thus CP). on the 2nd, all bases are intact. price didnt dip enough to clear them so no CP there. tell me if its not clear i'll draw it for you. the important thing to keep in mind on a 3drive is the clearing of any bases formed, so once it hits S/D price can move through the CPd bases easily. just my view.
